title: Spyglass: Unlocking Deeper Insights
summary: We are thrilled to officially launch Spyglass, delivering advanced discovery capabilities and clearer insights to elevate your experience.

title: Advanced File Control in Your Editor

summary: Experience effortless task management with our newly improved checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and seamlessly integrated into our modern design.

title: Enhanced Collaboration Experience
summary: We've upgraded the real-time editing experience, making it easier and more intuitive to collaborate seamlessly with your team.

title: Seamless Sharing and Collaboration

title: Worldwide Language Availability

summary: Effortlessly structure your ideas with dynamic content displays that provide flexible new ways to visualize and interact with your linked notes.

summary: Experience the official launch of Noeko, offering versatile self-hosted and convenient cloud-hosted solutions with tailored plans to empower your team.

summary: Prepare to transform your workspace with beautifully refined existing themes and an exciting collection of brand-new, diverse visual styles for ultimate personalization.
